IntrusiveNode subclass with an independent secondary link pair and key, unlinked separately.
Lazily loads groups from an ArchiveProvider using an ArchiveIndex, with packed and unpacked file caches.
RuntimeException retaining the original Throwable and an appended context string.
Canvas retaining a Component and forwarding paint and update callbacks.
Software RGB pixel array with transparent-zero blits, scaling and rotation.
Global integer framebuffer with static width, height, clip bounds and software drawing primitives.
Versioned group and file metadata: counts, ids, names and CRC/revision tables consumed by ResourceArchive.
Sprite base retaining full and trimmed dimensions and trim offsets.
Canvas with focus listener that owns a Frame for fullscreen presentation.
PacketBuffer subclass with an IsaacRandom opcode cipher and bit cursor.
Applet/Runnable with focus and window listeners and abstract init/render hooks; creates the GameCanvas.
Result and state arrays seeded with the golden-ratio constant; ISAAC generator for packet opcodes.
Sprite subclass whose blits use per-pixel high-byte alpha.
Two node links and a long key, subclassed by most pooled objects; same shared role as Ace IntrusiveNode.
Byte array with cursor and big-endian primitive and slice encodings; same shared role as Ace PacketBuffer.
Holds a sentinel pi and a traversal cursor; same shared role as Ace IntrusiveDeque.
Abstract linked PCM stream contract: next stream, mixer owner and sample mixing.
Abstract provider of the encoded index and groups consumed by ResourceArchive.

namingTool.adaptation: Resolve named member/local class binary prefixes from javac declaration simple names, preserving local ordinals and dollar characters. Compose containing-class renames recursively, including untouched top-level dollar names. Constructors, owner/type descriptors, literal loading, lexical labels and all bindings are recompiled and verified; output collisions fail before publication.
